text:
melissa_cs: Quick heads-up — EpochHealth wants an accelerated EU onboarding tomorrow morning (GAW 09:00 CET). They requested a temporary throughput bump and allowlisting of a set of peering IPs. Renewal flagged: customer mentioned contract upsell contingent on demo perf. Can eng/sre help make a 48–72h exception?
liam-se: Got it. Can you paste the CIDRs and the exact qps bump they're asking for? Also, do they need TCP peering or HTTP proxy route?
melissa_cs: They sent this list and said HTTP via our EU edge is fine. Request: +500 qps for 72h, auto-revoke after window. CIDRs:
```
185.62.72.0/24
203.0.113.128/26
2001:0db8:85a3::/64
```
melissa_cs: They also asked for header-based allowlist (x-customer-id) to add an extra guard.
jon-eng: Quick capacity check — +500 qps should be fine if we route to eu-west pool, but we need to reserve slots and set canary fallback to a smaller model variant if load spikes. Who owns the dedicated pool config?
dina-aml: Data residency question from legal: is any user payload touching non-EU control plane? Customer insists on EU-only handling for PII. We should confirm.
frank-support: Renewal note: Renewal is 30 days out, NPS 7 historically, but this onboarding demo outcome is high-leverage for expansion. Marking renewal-risk-high unless onboard goes smoothly.
sre-bot: ticket #INF-8421 created: "EpochHealth EU temp qps bump + CIDR allowlist" — assigned to eng-sre. ETA for provisioning: ~4h once security signoff received. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-8421
liam-se: Security: need a signed IP ownership attestation from the customer and a contact email. Also, we'll need the exact header value they will send for x-customer-id. Can we require TLS client certs?
melissa_cs: Customer contact is eva.lee@epochhealth.com. They confirmed header = "epoch-tenant-221" and attestation PDF attached in support ticket. They cannot do client certs for the demo.
jon-eng: Plan: 1) Add CIDRs to EU edge allowlist (HTTP ACL) 2) Apply header-based routing rule for epoch-tenant-221 3) Increase per-route qps +500 for 72h with auto-revoke 4) Add a canary route to model-compact if tokens latency > 250ms 5) Confirm all logs anonymized for legal.
dina-aml: I need an explicit note in the ticket that logs containing PII will not leave EU region — please set retention 7d and redact user identifiers in logs for this account.
liam-se: Ops commands (draft) — will run after attestation and legal signoff:
```
# add allowlist
redwood edge allowlist add --region eu-west --cidr 185.62.72.0/24 --account epochhealth
redwood edge allowlist add --region eu-west --cidr 203.0.113.128/26 --account epochhealth
# add header routing
redwood routes create --account epochhealth --region eu-west --match-header "x-customer-id=epoch-tenant-221" --route-id epochhealth-demo
# bump qps
redwood quotas update --account epochhealth --route epochhealth-demo --qps +500 --duration 72h --auto-revoke
```
frank-support: I'll add the renewal note and follow up with commercial for an ASAP upsell pitch if the demo metrics look good.
ops-bot: @channel Provisioning started for INF-8421 — job id job-99002. Estimated completion 3.5h.
melissa_cs: Thank you — can we get a confirmation once the header rule is live and the auto-revoke timer is set? Also please confirm the steps taken for audit trail.
jon-eng: Will do. I'll post the rollout log and a short post-deploy checklist in INF-8421 when done. Expect updates in ~2–3h. :thumbsup:
liam-se: Security reviewed attestation PDF in ticket, OK to proceed. Confirming EU-only control plane for this route.
melissa_cs: Awesome — adding a CI reminder to remind account exec to run the demo tests at 09:15 CET.
frank-support: Noted. Set renewal_followup = true on the account and ping commercial on success.
melissa_cs: Closing note: make this temporary window enforce auto-revoke and set an expiration alarm to avoid creeping quotas. Thanks all.
ops-bot: job-99002 completed — allowlist updated, route created, qps bump applied, auto-revoke scheduled for 72h after activation. Logs and audit entries attached to INF-8421.
jon-eng: Verified traffic routing in staging and observed healthy latency. Will monitor production ramp and trigger compact-model fallback at threshold.
melissa_cs: Perfect — I'll coordinate demo and report results. :raised_hands:
